project.name: FitBase
project.description: A home-gym AI coaching product + coach marketplace running as a custom Go PocketBase binary serving a buildless JS SPA.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent-facing build guide for the buildless frontend half of the app on webface.cloud, laying out hard rules (never build a server, same-origin PocketBase SDK, escape DOM content, keep it buildless) and canonical PocketBase JS SDK patterns.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Project memory documenting FitBase's custom Go PocketBase binary architecture — the two-halves split (buildless SPA frontend + server/ Go module), the operator build-and-ship path for the binary, server-side app.env config, and the collection model.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents a Go module using replace directives to import the webface.cloud platform, plus operator-only build/scp/systemctl deploy steps distinct from the git webhook.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Product and architecture overview for FitBase — the home-gym AI coach plus Stripe Connect coach marketplace — describing each server route file, the frontend SPA, the eight collections, exercise data/media licensing, and server config.

nodes.name: main.go
nodes.summary: Entry point for the custom Go PocketBase binary: binds the platform brand via pbbrand.Bind, runs ensureSchema on boot, registers the /api/ai, /api/invite, /api/billing and /hooks/stripe routes, and serves the SPA from pb_public with SPA fallback.
nodes.languageNotes: Routes are registered inside app.OnServe().BindFunc; auth-required routes chain .Bind(apis.RequireAuth()) while the Stripe webhook stays unauthenticated (signature-verified).

nodes.name: ai.go
nodes.summary: The server-side AI coach: equipment-aware plan generation and progression, calling Claude over raw HTTP with the Anthropic key held in app.env, validating returned exercise ids against the catalog and retrying, with per-user model tiering.
nodes.languageNotes: Talks to api.anthropic.com/v1/messages directly via net/http; DTO structs (planReq/planOut/planItem) shape the JSON contract; extractJSON salvages model output.

nodes.name: billing.go
nodes.summary: Stripe Connect marketplace backend: coach onboarding (Express accounts), client hire via Checkout with an application fee, and the signature-verified Stripe webhook that records engagements.
nodes.languageNotes: Form-encodes requests to api.stripe.com/v1; verifyStripeSig implements HMAC-SHA256 webhook signature checking; application fee derived from feeBps.

nodes.name: coach.go
nodes.summary: Coach marketplace invite system (mint/info/accept single-use tokens) plus ensureSchema, a self-healing routine that keeps collection shape (e.g. coach_name on services) in sync and backfills.

nodes.name: go.mod
nodes.summary: Go module manifest for fitbase.webface.cloud/server, pinning PocketBase and wiring the platform via a replace directive to the sibling webface-cloud checkout.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a local replace webface.cloud/platform => ../../webface-cloud so the binary shares pbbrand branding and retention with the platform.

nodes.name: POST /api/ai/plan
nodes.summary: Auth-required route that generates an equipment-aware, multi-day workout plan by prompting Claude, validating exercise ids against the catalog and retrying on invalid output.

nodes.name: POST /api/ai/progress
nodes.summary: Auth-required route that suggests next-session sets/reps/weight progression for a workout based on recent logged history via Claude.

nodes.name: POST /api/invite
nodes.summary: Auth-required route where a coach invites someone by email, minting a single-use token and returning the accept link.

nodes.name: POST /api/invite/accept
nodes.summary: Auth-required route where the signed-in invitee accepts an invite token (single-use), establishing the coach/client membership.

nodes.name: GET /api/invite/{token}
nodes.summary: Public route returning invite details for the accept page given a token.

nodes.name: POST /api/billing/connect
nodes.summary: Auth-required coach onboarding route that creates or reuses a Stripe Express connected account and returns an onboarding link.

nodes.name: GET /api/billing/status
nodes.summary: Auth-required route reporting the coach's onboarding and payout-readiness status.

nodes.name: POST /api/billing/hire
nodes.summary: Auth-required route where a client hires a coach's service, creating a Stripe Checkout session with an application fee and returning the checkout URL.

nodes.name: POST /hooks/stripe
nodes.summary: Unauthenticated but Stripe-signature-verified webhook that processes checkout/subscription events and records the resulting coach-client engagement.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Constructs the branded PocketBase app, registers all custom API routes and the SPA static handler inside OnServe, and starts the server.

nodes.name: handleAIPlan
nodes.summary: Handler for POST /api/ai/plan: builds equipment-scoped candidate exercises, prompts Claude for a structured plan, validates ex_ids and retries, then materializes workouts for the user.

nodes.name: handleAIProgress
nodes.summary: Handler for POST /api/ai/progress: gathers a workout's recent session history and asks Claude for per-exercise progression suggestions.

nodes.name: callClaudeJSON
nodes.summary: Low-level Claude client: POSTs a system/user prompt to the Anthropic messages API and extracts a JSON object from the response.

nodes.name: selectCandidates
nodes.summary: Selects catalog exercises the user can actually perform given their owned equipment, producing the candidate set the model is constrained to.

nodes.name: resolvePlan
nodes.summary: Determines the effective plan/model tier for a user (comp accounts vs free vs paid) driving which Claude model is used.

nodes.name: handleBillingConnect
nodes.summary: Handler for POST /api/billing/connect: creates or reuses a Stripe Express account for the coach and returns an account onboarding link.

nodes.name: handleBillingStatus
nodes.summary: Handler for GET /api/billing/status: returns the coach's onboarding and payout-readiness flags.

nodes.name: handleBillingHire
nodes.summary: Handler for POST /api/billing/hire: creates a Stripe Checkout session for a service with a marketplace application fee routed to the coach's connected account.

nodes.name: handleStripeWebhook
nodes.summary: Handler for POST /hooks/stripe: verifies the Stripe signature then processes checkout/subscription events, recording the engagement.

nodes.name: stripeForm
nodes.summary: Form-encodes and POSTs a request to the Stripe REST API, returning the decoded JSON response.

nodes.name: verifyStripeSig
nodes.summary: Verifies a Stripe webhook signature header via HMAC-SHA256 against the signing secret with a constant-time compare.

nodes.name: linkEngagement
nodes.summary: Records or updates a coach-client engagement record tying together the service, checkout session and Stripe subscription.

nodes.name: ensureSchema
nodes.summary: Self-healing schema routine run at boot: ensures marketplace collection fields (e.g. coach_name on services) exist and backfills them.

nodes.name: handleInviteCreate
nodes.summary: Handler for POST /api/invite: mints a single-use invite token for an emailed invitee and returns the accept link.

nodes.name: handleInviteInfo
nodes.summary: Handler for GET /api/invite/{token}: returns public invite details for the accept page.

nodes.name: handleInviteAccept
nodes.summary: Handler for POST /api/invite/accept: consumes the single-use token for the signed-in invitee and creates the coach/client membership.

nodes.name: DESIGN.md
nodes.summary: Design notes (2026-07-19) capturing FitBase's what/decisions/collections: the custom Go PocketBase binary, server-side AI coach routes, and the planned coach-marketplace collections.

nodes.name: app.css
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the buildless SPA shell: dark-theme design tokens (CSS variables), layout for the exercise grid, cards, modals, workout editor, and session/coach views.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CSS custom properties (:root variables) for theming across the whole SPA.

nodes.name: app.js
nodes.summary: The entire FitBase SPA: a hash router with views for the exercise library, workouts, session logging, history, My Gym, coach marketplace and dashboard, plus AI-plan/progress modals and hire/invite flows, all driven by the same-origin PocketBase JS SDK.
nodes.languageNotes: Buildless vanilla JS: global functions wired to inline onclick handlers, template-literal HTML, and pb.send() calls to the server's custom /api routes. All DB strings escaped via esc() before DOM insertion.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: The SPA shell: mounts the nav, view container, modal overlay and toast, and loads the vendored PocketBase UMD SDK plus app.css and app.js.

nodes.name: deploy.sh
nodes.summary: Operator deploy script that cross-compiles the Go binary for linux/amd64, scp's it to the droplet and restarts the wfc-fitbase systemd unit, and separately ships the public/ frontend into the app's pb_public.

nodes.name: setup_fitbase.py
nodes.summary: One-shot backend bootstrap: authenticates as superuser, ensures the exercises/workouts/sessions collections exist with their schema and indexes, and seeds the exercise dataset.

nodes.name: req
nodes.summary: Thin HTTP helper that issues authenticated JSON requests against the PocketBase admin API and returns (status, parsed-body).

nodes.name: ensure_collection
nodes.summary: Idempotently creates a PocketBase collection from a payload, skipping it when a collection of that name already exists.

nodes.name: route
nodes.summary: The hash router: parses location.hash into a view name plus params, highlights the active nav item, and dispatches to the matching render function.

nodes.name: renderAuth
nodes.summary: Renders the sign-in/sign-up form view with a toggle between login and registration modes.

nodes.name: doAuth
nodes.summary: Handles auth submit: creates the user on sign-up, authenticates with password via the PocketBase users collection, then honors any pending post-login redirect.

nodes.name: renderLibrary
nodes.summary: Renders the exercise library view: loads the catalog and gym profile, builds category/equipment/target filter controls, and wires filter events to repaint the grid.

nodes.name: renderGym
nodes.summary: Renders the My Gym view where a user toggles which equipment they own; persists the selection to the gym_profiles collection.

nodes.name: paintGrid
nodes.summary: Paints the filtered, paginated exercise card grid into the library container.

nodes.name: openDetail
nodes.summary: Opens the exercise detail modal: fetches the full exercise record, shows the animated GIF, muscles, per-language instructions and step list.

nodes.name: renderWorkouts
nodes.summary: Renders the Workouts list view: existing workouts with edit/start/delete actions plus create-new and AI-plan entry points.

nodes.name: openAIPlan
nodes.summary: Opens the AI plan-generation modal collecting goal, days/week, session length, experience and injuries before requesting an equipment-aware plan.

nodes.name: doAIPlan
nodes.summary: Submits the AI plan request to POST /api/ai/plan, then reloads and re-renders the generated workouts.

nodes.name: renderWorkoutEditor
nodes.summary: Renders the single-workout editor: reorderable exercise items with sets/reps inputs plus an AI progression suggestion action.

nodes.name: suggestProgress
nodes.summary: Requests AI progression via POST /api/ai/progress using the workout's recent history and renders the suggested next sets/reps/weight in a modal.

nodes.name: applyProgress
nodes.summary: Applies the AI-suggested progression back onto the workout's items and saves them.

nodes.name: startSession
nodes.summary: Begins a live logging session from a workout, seeding per-exercise set entries in local state.

nodes.name: renderSession
nodes.summary: Renders the active workout-logging session UI with per-set reps/weight inputs and add/delete-set controls.

nodes.name: finishSession
nodes.summary: Finalizes a session, persisting the logged sets to the sessions collection and returning to the workouts view.

nodes.name: renderHistory
nodes.summary: Renders the workout history view listing past logged sessions.

nodes.name: renderCoach
nodes.summary: Renders the coach dashboard: payout/onboarding status, services management, client invites and the coach's engaged clients.

nodes.name: createService
nodes.summary: Creates a new coaching service offering for the signed-in coach.

nodes.name: sendInvite
nodes.summary: Sends a client/coach invite by email via POST /api/invite and surfaces the returned invite link.

nodes.name: renderCoaches
nodes.summary: Renders the Find a Coach marketplace view listing available coaching services with a hire action.

nodes.name: hireService
nodes.summary: Initiates hiring a coach's service via POST /api/billing/hire and redirects the client to Stripe Checkout.

nodes.name: renderAccept
nodes.summary: Renders the invite-accept page: fetches invite info via GET /api/invite/{token} and accepts it via POST /api/invite/accept once signed in.

nodes.name: renderHome
nodes.summary: Renders the marketing landing page for signed-out visitors, describing the AI coach and coach marketplace with calls to action.

tour.title: What FitBase Is
tour.description: Start with the README to understand the product before any code. FitBase is not just an exercise log — it is a home-gym AI coaching product paired with a Stripe Connect coach marketplace. The through-line to keep in mind for the whole tour: a member inventories the equipment they own, the AI builds them a plan from it, they log and progress, and they can optionally hire a real coach who gets paid through the platform. The README also names each server route file, the SPA, and the eight collections, so it doubles as a map for the steps ahead.

tour.title: The Architectural Key: A Custom Go Binary
tour.description: This is the decision everything else depends on. Most webface.cloud apps are buildless static SPAs, but FitBase ships as a CUSTOM Go PocketBase binary — and that is what unlocks trusted server-side code. main.go is the entry point: it binds the platform brand, runs ensureSchema on boot to self-heal the collections, registers the /api/ai, /api/invite, /api/billing and /hooks/stripe routes, then serves the SPA from pb_public with an SPA fallback. Because these routes run server-side, the Anthropic key and Stripe secrets live in app.env and never touch the browser. CLAUDE.md documents this two-halves split (buildless frontend + Go server module), and go.mod pins PocketBase and wires in the platform via a replace directive.
tour.languageLesson: Go's PocketBase-as-a-framework pattern: instead of running the stock PocketBase binary, you import it as a module and register your own routes in main(), producing a single self-contained static binary that is both the database and the API server.

tour.title: The AI Coach
tour.description: This is the heart of the product and the first server route file to read. ai.go generates an equipment-aware weekly plan by prompting Claude over raw HTTP — it only proposes moves the member can actually do with the gear in their My Gym inventory. Critically, it validates every returned exercise id against the catalog and retries on invalid output, so the coach never hallucinates a nonexistent movement. The POST /api/ai/plan endpoint builds the multi-day plan, while POST /api/ai/progress reads recent logged sessions and suggests progressive overload (next-session sets, reps, and weight). Both are auth-required, and both keep the Anthropic key server-side per the architecture from Step 2.

tour.title: The Coach Marketplace: Invites
tour.description: Once a member has an AI plan, FitBase lets them bring in a human coach — and coach.go is where that relationship begins. A coach invites a client by email via POST /api/invite, which mints a single-use token and returns an accept link; GET /api/invite/{token} is the public route that reads invite details for the accept page; and POST /api/invite/accept establishes the coach/client membership when the signed-in invitee accepts. This file also houses ensureSchema — the same self-healing routine main.go runs on boot — which keeps collection shape (like coach_name on services) in sync and backfills existing rows.

tour.title: Billing: Stripe Connect Payouts
tour.description: The marketplace only works if coaches get paid, and billing.go is the Stripe Connect backend that closes the loop from Step 4. A coach onboards for payouts through POST /api/billing/connect, which creates or reuses a Stripe Express connected account, while GET /api/billing/status reports payout readiness. When a client hires a coach, POST /api/billing/hire opens a Stripe Checkout session that takes a 15% application fee for the platform. Finally, POST /hooks/stripe is an unauthenticated but signature-verified webhook that processes the checkout event and records the resulting coach-client engagement — the moment money and relationship become official.
tour.languageLesson: Stripe Connect marketplaces: the platform holds the Stripe account, coaches are Express connected accounts, and Checkout's application_fee_amount routes a cut to the platform while the rest goes to the coach. Webhooks must be signature-verified because they are the one endpoint Stripe (not your authenticated user) calls.

tour.title: The Buildless Frontend SPA
tour.description: Everything so far is server-side; app.js is the entire client. It is one buildless single-page app — a hash router with views for the exercise library, workouts, session logging, history, My Gym, the coach dashboard, find-a-coach, and the landing page — all driven by the same-origin PocketBase JS SDK. It is the wiring that calls every server route you just read: doAIPlan hits /api/ai/plan, suggestProgress hits /api/ai/progress, hireService hits /api/billing/hire, and sendInvite hits /api/invite. index.html is the shell that mounts the nav, view container, modal, and toast and loads the vendored PocketBase UMD SDK plus app.css. AGENTS.md captures the hard rules for this half: never build a server, escape DOM content, stay buildless.
tour.languageLesson: A buildless SPA ships raw JS with no bundler or transpile step — the browser loads app.js directly and a vendored UMD SDK provides the PocketBase client. A hash router (reading window.location.hash) gives client-side navigation without any server routing config.

tour.title: Seeding the Backend
tour.description: To run FitBase from scratch you first need the data model and the exercise catalog the AI coach validates against. setup_fitbase.py is a one-shot bootstrap that authenticates as the PocketBase superuser, ensures the exercises, workouts, and sessions collections exist with their schema and indexes, and seeds the exercise dataset. This is the counterpart to the ensureSchema routine from Steps 2 and 4 — together they guarantee the collections the whole app assumes are always present and populated.
tour.languageLesson: PocketBase exposes an admin REST API, so bootstrap tooling can be written in any language — here Python authenticates as superuser and PUT/POSTs collection schemas idempotently, making the script safe to re-run.

tour.title: Shipping It
tour.description: The capstone ties the two halves back together for production. Because FitBase is a custom binary (Step 2), you cannot just sync static files — deploy.sh cross-compiles the Go binary for linux/amd64, scp's it to the droplet, and restarts the wfc-fitbase systemd unit, then separately ships the public/ frontend into the app's pb_public. That single script is the whole operator path from source to the live fitbase.webface.cloud instance, delivering both the server routes and the SPA that calls them.
tour.languageLesson: Go cross-compilation: setting GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 produces a single static Linux binary from any dev machine with no runtime dependencies to install on the server — deploy becomes scp-the-binary and restart-the-service.
